title: Migrate the standards pack and project standards file to the one record schema
body:
Why: t-ea10z3f shipped the one budgeted lane packet but kept the Standard shape for standards/records.json, .agents/standards.json and adopt.
Outcome: standards/records.json and the adopt-seeded project file use the src/brain/record.ts schema; the standardRecord adapter is deleted; lanePacket reads only that schema.
Proof: lanePacket reads both files with parseUnified; no import of standardRecord remains.
